decisions.statement: Item ids are mined in batches rather than in one run.
A batch hands the game back to the player before the next batch starts.
An item id the game names nothing for is counted as a miss.
Completed item mining starts quest mining.
Mining resumes from the last id rather than from the first.
A generation count makes stopped mining drop its own queued batch.

definition: what the game says about every item, taken one item id at a time
